title: Node.js Login System with bcrypt

title: Local Notes
desc: QuickNotes is my first React application, The app allows users to write notes, save them locally using localStorage, and retrieve them later by key. This project helped me learn how React handles form inputs, conditional rendering, and persistent data without using a backend.

title: HomeCare
desc: HomeCare is a web application built for a real client to handle home service bookings. Users can send requests directly through EmailJS. I developed most of the project, including the design and frontend, with partial collaboration from a friend. This project gave me practical experience in building and delivering a real-world solution.

title: Full Stack Blog App
desc: A complete full-stack blogging platform built using React (Vite) for the frontend and Node.js with Express and MySQL for the backend. It includes authentication, CRUD operations for blog posts, image uploads with Multer, featured posts, user dashboard, search functionality, and user analytics like post count.
